gaps.title: Missing Frontend Edit and Delete (Management)
gaps.jtbd: When a protocol needs updates or removal, I want to edit or delete it via the UI, so that I can manage epidemiological materials as requested.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a logged-in user viewing a material, When they click Edit or Delete, Then the material is updated or removed from the system.
gaps.reason: The original brief explicitly asks for 'управления' (managing). While the backend has update/delete endpoints, the frontend currently lacks any UI to edit or delete materials.

gaps.title: Missing Authentication System
gaps.jtbd: When accessing the system, I want to authenticate, so that sensitive epidemiological protocols and data are protected.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the system, Then they are prompted to log in.
gaps.reason: Domain-standard expectation: A knowledge base managing epidemiological materials and protocols requires authentication, especially since the UI already marks documents as 'Security Classification: Restricted'.
